text:
I need to recall the iconic Sgt. Pepper's Lonely Hearts Club Band album cover from 1967.

The album cover features The Beatles in colorful military-style band uniforms standing among cardboard cutouts of famous figures. In the photograph, Paul McCartney is holding a cor anglais (English horn), not a trumpet. Ringo Starr is holding a trumpet in the photo.

The other agents answered Paul McCartney, but this appears to be incorrect based on my knowledge of this famous album cover. Ringo Starr is the one holding the trumpet.

Answer: Ringo Starr
Confidence: 0.85
